tools.name: officernd_get_organization
tools.description: Fetch the OfficeRnD organization these credentials belong to — name, slug and region. A cheap way to confirm the setup works. OfficeRnD: GET /api/v2/organizations/{orgSlug}.

tools.name: officernd_list_locations
tools.description: List the organization's locations (coworking spaces/buildings) with address, timezone and open/public flags. Location _ids are needed by most other filters and by officernd_create_member. OfficeRnD: GET /locations.

tools.name: officernd_list_members
tools.description: List members (people) of the workspace, filterable by exact email or name, location, company, status and creation/modification date. OfficeRnD: GET /members.

tools.name: officernd_get_member
tools.description: Fetch one member by _id — contact details, company, location, status, billing details and custom properties. OfficeRnD: GET /members/{memberId}.

tools.name: officernd_list_companies
tools.description: List companies (teams/tenants renting space), filterable by exact name or _id, location and status. OfficeRnD: GET /companies.

tools.name: officernd_list_resources
tools.description: List bookable/assignable resources — meeting rooms, desks, hot desks, private offices — with capacity, price, rate, floor and amenities. Resource _ids are needed by officernd_create_booking. OfficeRnD: GET /resources.

tools.name: officernd_list_bookings
tools.description: List bookings: one entry per one-off booking and one per recurring series (first instance only). Filter by member, company, location, resource, series start window and status. For every individual occurrence in a date window use officernd_list_booking_occurrences. OfficeRnD: GET /bookings.

tools.name: officernd_list_booking_occurrences
tools.description: List every individual booking occurrence between two times — one-off bookings plus each expanded instance of recurring series. The right tool for calendars, room availability and utilisation. Without pagination the window may be at most 1 year. OfficeRnD: GET /bookings/occurrences.

tools.name: officernd_get_booking
tools.description: Fetch one booking by _id — resource, member/company, times, recurrence rule, fees, extras, visitors and status. OfficeRnD: GET /bookings/{bookingId}.

tools.name: officernd_list_memberships
tools.description: List memberships (recurring plans sold to members/companies) with plan, price, discount, start/end dates and calculated status. OfficeRnD: GET /memberships.

tools.name: officernd_list_contracts
tools.description: List contracts (agreements for plans and resources) with totals, dates, notice period, status and lifecycle stage — e.g. find contracts up for renewal or serving notice. OfficeRnD: GET /contracts.

tools.name: officernd_list_checkins
tools.description: List member check-ins (who was on site, when, and via which booking or pass) — useful for occupancy and attendance. OfficeRnD: GET /checkins.

tools.name: officernd_list_payments
tools.description: List billing documents — invoices, credit notes, overpayments — with totals, paid/pending amounts, due dates and status. Filter by member, company, location, document type, status, number and issue/due date (e.g. overdue invoices). OfficeRnD: GET /payments.

tools.name: officernd_list_tickets
tools.description: List helpdesk tickets (member requests/issues) with subject, message, status (open/new/pending/resolved), priority, severity and assignee. OfficeRnD: GET /tickets.

tools.name: officernd_list_ticket_options
tools.description: List the helpdesk ticket options — the configured types, priorities and severities (each with an _id, category and label). Their _ids are required by officernd_create_ticket. OfficeRnD: GET /ticket-options.

tools.name: officernd_create_member
tools.description: WRITE. Add a new member (person) to a location, optionally attached to a company. Needs scope flex.community.members.create. OfficeRnD: POST /members.

tools.name: officernd_update_member
tools.description: WRITE. Update a member's name, email, phone, start date, billing/contact flags, tags or custom properties. Only the fields you pass are changed; `tags` replaces the whole tag list. Needs scope flex.community.members.update. OfficeRnD: PUT /members/{memberId}.

tools.name: officernd_create_booking
tools.description: WRITE. Book a resource (e.g. a meeting room) for a member and/or company. Unless is_free or is_tentative is set, the booking is charged per the resource's rate, and the member is notified unless is_silent. Needs scope flex.space.bookings.create. OfficeRnD: POST /bookings.

tools.name: officernd_create_ticket
tools.description: WRITE. Open a helpdesk ticket on behalf of a member. type, priority and severity are ticket-option _ids from officernd_list_ticket_options. Needs scope flex.collaboration.tickets.create. OfficeRnD: POST /tickets.

tools.name: officernd_add_ticket_comment
tools.description: WRITE. Post a comment on a helpdesk ticket. Public comments are visible to the member; comments attributed to members must be public. Needs scope flex.collaboration.ticketComments.create. OfficeRnD: POST /ticket-comments/{ticketId}.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "officernd_get_organization" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: officernd_list_members, officernd_list_payments, officernd_list_tickets, officernd_list_ticket_options, officernd_update_member, officernd_create_ticket · Private data: officernd_get_organization, officernd_get_member, officernd_list_resources, officernd_list_payments, officernd_update_member · Public sink: officernd_list_members, officernd_create_member, officernd_update_member, officernd_create_booking, officernd_create_ticket, officernd_add_ticket_comment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: officernd_list_members, officernd_list_payments, officernd_list_tickets, officernd_list_ticket_options, officernd_update_member, officernd_create_ticket · Private data: officernd_get_organization, officernd_get_member, officernd_list_resources, officernd_list_payments, officernd_update_member · Public sink: officernd_list_members, officernd_create_member, officernd_update_member, officernd_create_booking, officernd_create_ticket, officernd_add_ticket_comment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
